description: Implementation of MetalCommandBuffer class for managing Metal command buffers within the PyTorch framework's Metal backend. Handles thread-local buffer retrieval, delegate notifications, image management, and synchronization.

classes.name: MetalCommandBuffer
classes.description: A class managing Metal command buffer lifecycle, thread-local storage, delegates, and temporary image recycling within the PyTorch Metal backend.

methods.name: newBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new MetalCommandBuffer instance with a new Metal command buffer and initializes delegate and image collections.

methods.name: currentBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-local instance of MetalCommandBuffer, creating and initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the command buffer exists and is in a valid state (status == 0).

methods.name: addSubscriber:
methods.description: Adds a delegate object conforming to PTMetalCommandBuffer protocol to receive synchronization callbacks.

methods.name: removeSubscriber:
methods.description: Removes a delegate object from the delegate set.

methods.name: add:
methods.description: Adds a temporary image to the list for recycling after command buffer execution.

methods.name: remove:
methods.description: Removes a temporary image from the list.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the command buffer if it is in a valid state, wrapping the begin and end synchronization routines.

methods.name: beginSynchronization
methods.description: Notifies all delegates to begin synchronization and recycles all temporary images.

methods.name: endSynchronization:
methods.description: Notifies all delegates to end synchronization, clears delegate and image collections, and removes thread-local storage.

methods.name: isEqual:
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the buffer reference.
